theater: 普魯士中部與東普魯士

battle.name: 第四次反法同盟
battle.theater: 普魯士中部與東普魯士
battle.brief: 1806 年 10 月普魯士對法國宣戰，第四次反法同盟開打。拿破崙以軍團縱深穿插，八天內在耶拿與奧爾施泰特擊潰普軍主力；繼而轉戰波蘭與東普魯士，於埃爾勞、海爾斯貝格與弗里德蘭與俄軍血戰。板甲胸甲這時只剩老近衛與近衛騎兵身上的儀仗防護，抵擋不了砲彈。

kit.name: 板甲胸甲
kit.history: 鍛鐵的胸甲讓步槍變成冷兵器。馬爾科·波佐多的改變比任何一場戰役都快。

countries:
1806 年秋天的歐洲分成兩個對立的集團。反法同盟一方由普魯士王國先開火：國王腓特烈·威廉三世在柏林召集參謀會議，實際戰術由不倫瑞克公爵腓特烈·威廉主持，普軍與薩克森、威爾騰堡等小邦的部隊組成聯軍，奧地利帝國在西線由霍拉維茨等人分區指揮，主力部署在加利西亞與波希米亞方向；俄羅斯帝國由亞歷山大一世掛名，作戰由本尼格森等將領指揮，步兵以師與旅編成集團軍；英國無法在陸上投入主力，改以皇家海軍封鎖北海與波羅的海航線，維持海外遠征與小規模登陸兵力，1807 年瑞典再以裝甲帶與海軍加入同盟。
法國一方由法蘭西第一帝國主導，拿破崙自任全軍最高統帥，總參謀部由貝蒂埃主持，蘇爾特、奈伊、達武分率的軍團加上近衛軍、穆拉率領的騎兵預備軍與莫羅部構成本部攻勢，義大利方面軍由本內多托內指揮、負責壓制南線；巴伐里亞、符騰堡、薩克森等萊茵邦聯國家以附屬軍形式參戰，熱羅姆·波拿巴的威斯特伐利亞公國與拿破崙王國的義大利王國分別在西面與南面牽制奧地利，普軍投降後成立的華沙公國則為法軍提供波蘭兵源與徵召額度。
countriesEn:
Europe in the autumn of 1806 split into two opposing blocs. The anti-French coalition opened the war with the Kingdom of Prussia: King Frederick William III convened his war council in Berlin while the tactical direction in the field rested with Duke Frederick William of Brunswick, and Prussian troops were combined with contingents from Saxony, Württemberg and other small states. Austria ruled the western front in separate sectors under commanders such as Horvath, with her main strength still in Galicia and Bohemia. Russia fought under the name of Alexander I, the actual operations being run by generals such as Bennigsen, its infantry organised into corps of divisions and brigades. Britain could not commit a major land force and instead relied on the Royal Navy to blockade the North Sea and the Baltic routes while maintaining expeditionary forces and small amphibious landings; Sweden joined the coalition with its belt and fleet in 1807.
On the French side the French Empire took the lead, with Napoleon as supreme commander, the general staff headed by Bertrand, and Soult's, Ney's and Davout's corps, supported by the Imperial Guard and Murat's cavalry reserve under Moreau, forming the main striking force. The Army of Italy under Beauharnais pinned the southern front. The Rhenish Confederation states of Bavaria, Württemberg and Saxony entered the war with contingents of their own; the Kingdom of Westphalia of Jérôme Bonaparte and the Kingdom of Italy of Napoleon constrained Austria in the west and south respectively; and after the Prussian collapse the new Duchy of Warsaw supplied France with Polish manpower and recruitment quotas.
people:
拿破崙是整場戰爭的樞紐。1806 年 10 月初他把三個軍團同時壓向普魯士，先在薩爾費爾德擊破不倫瑞克公爵的前鋒，十月十四日以一天之內在耶拿與奧爾施泰特兩地擊潰普軍主力；此後他讓莫羅與拉爾納分頭追擊殘敵，又在布爾根蘭方向親自督戰，之後把戰略重心轉往波蘭與東普魯士。普魯士方面，國王腓特烈·威廉三世在耶拿附近受重創後失去繼續抵抗的意志，不倫瑞克公爵於奧爾施泰特陣亡，普軍各縱隊指揮官如克勞岑、齊根菲爾德各自為戰、全無協同；慘敗之後由布蘭登堡元帥海因里希·布呂歇爾收拾殘兵，在東普魯士重建由義勇軍與游擊隊構成的抵抗力量。
俄國的關鍵人物是亞歷山大一世，他兩度自任全軍統帥：埃爾勞戰役中俄軍靠冬季嚴寒與縱深守住了陣地，海爾斯貝格又以反斜面陣形擊退法軍攻勢，但弗里德蘭一戰全軍崩潰，他被迫在蒂爾西特與拿破崙會晤並接受極苛刻的條款。俄軍將領中，本尼格森在波羅的海沿岸長期周旋，彼得·巴格拉季昂以縱隊掩護撤退，巴克萊·德·托利隨後接掌指揮權；法軍方面的奈伊、拉爾納、索朗與參謀總長貝蒂埃是連續攻勢的執行者。英國方面，小威廉·皮特主持海上封鎖，詹姆斯·薩馬雷茲率分遣隊進入波羅的海，愛德華·帕克在 1807 年炮擊哥本哈根、奪走丹麥海軍國旗。波蘭方面，1807 年成立的華沙公國由亞當·耶日·恰爾托雷斯基出任親王，隨後落入法國的直接控制之下。
peopleEn:
Napoleon was the pivot of the entire war. In early October 1806 he drove three corps simultaneously against Prussia, breaking the advance guard of the Duke of Brunswick at Saalfeld and, within a single day on 14 October, destroying the bulk of the Prussian army at Jena and Auerstedt. He then sent Moreau and Lannes after the broken formations and personally directed operations in the direction of Hollabrunn before shifting the strategic centre of gravity to Poland and East Prussia. On the Prussian side King Frederick William III was badly shaken near Jena and lost the will to continue resisting; the Duke of Brunswick was killed at Auerstedt; and commanders such as Kleist and Zeugenthirn fought isolated, uncoordinated actions. After the collapse the field marshal Heinrich von Blücher gathered the remnants and rebuilt a resistance of Landwehr and partisan bands in East Prussia.
The key Russian figure was Alexander I, who twice took personal command: at Eylau the Russian army held its positions through the severity of the winter and the depth of its lines, and at Heilsberg a reverse-slope position turned back the French assault, but the army broke at Friedland and the tsar was forced to meet Napoleon at Tilsit on humiliating terms. Among the Russian generals Bennigsen manoeuvred for months along the Baltic coast, Pyotr Bagration covered the withdrawal with his columns, and Barclay de Tolly afterwards took over command; on the French side Ney, Lannes, Soult and the chief of staff Bertrand carried out the continuous offensive. In Britain the younger Pitt directed the maritime blockade, James Saumarez led a detachment into the Baltic, and Edward Parker bombarded Copenhagen in 1807, carrying off the Danish naval flag. In Poland, the Duchy of Warsaw set up in 1807 was given to Adam Jerzy Czartoryski as prince, and soon fell under direct French control.
kits:
板甲胸甲在這場戰爭裡已經不是前裝時代的裝甲，而是少數精銳部隊的儀仗與防護裝備。這種十六世紀西班牙式的鍛鐵胸甲源自十五世紀末至十六世紀初的板金工藝，配有高領護頸與護肩，通常與同套的背甲合用；到 1806 年它主要出現在幾個地方：法國老近衛的胸甲騎兵與擲彈騎兵在出發與檢閱時披掛黑藍色的鋼甲，英國第一與第二騎兵衛隊的近衛騎兵團長期配發鍍黑鋼製胸甲，俄國近衛胸甲騎兵團同樣備有胸甲與背甲。實戰之中它們的價值有限：對手槍、刺刀與馬刀尚有防護力，但對火炮破片幾乎毫無作用，1807 年 2 月埃爾勞的猛烈炮擊中，法軍騎兵連人帶馬被掀翻在雪地裡。
真正決定勝負的仍是火器。英軍大量配備 .577 英寸口徑的燧發滑膛步槍，法軍使用 1777 年型步槍與騎槍、卡賓槍，俄軍則是火繩與燧發混用的線列步槍；炮兵方面，法軍有 4 磅、6 磅、8 磅野戰炮與 12 磅炮，編為獨立的炮兵旅，會在步兵縱隊展開時前出占領陣地，普軍野戰炮數量較少且多為 3 磅與 4 磅，攻城則靠圍城砲與攻城器材。輕步兵使用擲彈筒，騎兵除胸甲騎兵外還有龍騎兵與匈牙利式輕騎兵。後勤方面，法軍工程兵以制式橋車跨越河流，靠軍需官體系與就地徵發維持遠距離作戰，馬匹補充同樣仰賴徵用。
kitsEn: By 1806 the cuirass was no longer a piece of full-armour protection but the ceremonial and personal defence of a few elite units. This Spanish-style forged breastplate of iron and steel grew out of sixteenth-century plate work, carried a high gorget and shoulder defences, and was normally worn with a matching backplate; by 1806 it survived mainly in a few places. The carabiniers and horse grenadiers of the French Old Guard rode out in blackened blued steel, the British Household Cavalry brigades were long issued with blackened steel cuirasses, and the Russian Life Guard cuirassier regiments wore breastplate and backplate alike. Its battlefield value was limited: it stopped pistol fire, sabre cuts and bayonets, but was useless against artillery fragments, and during the heavy bombardment at Eylau in February 1807 French cavalry were thrown from their horses into the snow. What actually decided the war was firearms. The British army carried .577 inch flintlock muskets in bulk, the French used the 1777 pattern musket with carbines and pistols, and the Russians mixed matchlock and flintlock line infantry; on the artillery side the French fielded 4, 6 and 8-pounder guns with 12-pounders, formed into independent artillery brigades that pushed forward to seize positions while the infantry columns deployed, whereas Prussian artillery was smaller in number and mostly 3- and 4-pounders, with siege guns reserved for sieges. Light infantry carried grenade throwers; the cavalry included cuirassiers alongside dragoons and Hungarian-style light horse. Logistically the French engineers bridged rivers with pontoon wagons, and the whole army ran on the intendant system and on requisition from the country, horses included.
tactics:
法軍在整場戰爭裡的操作圍繞三件事：快速行軍、集中砲兵、縱深突破。1806 年 10 月初各軍團連續夜行軍穿越圖林根丘陵，10 月 14 日同時在耶拿與奧爾施泰特方向展開：步兵師以縱隊行進，到達陣位後由營縱隊連續展開成射擊線，炮兵旅與師屬炮兵前推到陣地前沿提供遮蔽，騎兵預備隊留在第一線之後待命，一旦普軍步兵被牽制或側翼暴露便實施衝擊。薩爾費爾德與布爾根蘭方向的追擊戰顯示，普軍各縱隊之間缺乏協同，被分割成互相不能支援的小股，這是耶拿慘敗的技術原因。
轉入波蘭與東普魯士後，形勢轉為戰役縱深與消耗。俄軍利用維爾納河的河防與托爾高夫一線的陣地遲滯法軍推進；法軍在埃爾勞被迫在暴雪與嚴寒中作戰，步兵方陣與縱隊都被大量消耗；海爾斯貝格一役俄軍據守反斜面陣地，以密集縱隊射擊驅逐法軍前哨；弗里德蘭則是典型的迂回合圍，拉爾納與莫羅部沿普爾圖斯方向渡過阿列河，達武部在右翼建立掩護，最終以多個縱隊同時壓上，把俄軍擠向阿列河與冰面。海上英軍以分遣隊封鎖波羅的海入口，1807 年迫使丹麥中止對英國的供應，同年 9 月炮擊哥本哈根，摧毀丹麥艦隊並奪走國旗。後勤上，法軍在敵境靠徵發解決糧秣，普軍則靠國土補給，義勇軍與游擊隊在撤退階段切斷法軍交通線。
tacticsEn:
French operations in this war turned on three things: rapid marching, concentration of artillery, and attacks in depth. In early October 1806 the corps marched by night across the Thuringian uplands, and on 14 October deployed simultaneously toward Jena and Auerstedt. Infantry divisions advanced in column, and on reaching their positions were formed up in succession by battalion into a firing line; artillery brigades and divisional guns pushed forward to the front of the position to give cover; and the cavalry reserve was held back behind the first line, ready to charge the moment Prussian infantry was pinned or its flank exposed. The pursuit actions around Saalfeld and toward Hollabrunn showed that the Prussian columns lacked coordination and were broken up into small bodies unable to support one another, which was the technical cause of the Jena disaster.
In Poland and East Prussia the contest turned into a war of depth and attrition. The Russians used the defences of the Vistula and the Torgau line to slow the French advance; at Eylau the French were forced to fight in blizzard and bitter cold and were badly thinned in both square and column; at Heilsberg the Russians held reverse-slope positions and drove back the French pickets with massed volleys; and at Friedland the French executed their classic turning movement, Lannes and Moreau crossing the Alle toward the Pultusk direction while Davout covered the right, until several columns pressed forward together and pushed the Russians towards the river and the ice. At sea the British detached squadrons blockaded the Baltic entrances, forced Denmark to stop supplying Britain in 1807, and in September bombarded Copenhagen, destroying the Danish fleet and carrying off the national flag. On the logistics side the French fed themselves by requisition in enemy country, the Prussians by the resources of the homeland, and the Landwehr and partisans cut French communications during the withdrawal.
data:
關於兵員與損失，各家史料的數字互有出入，以下採較常見的估計，並註明不確定之處。1806 年 10 月的戰役中，拿破崙可用兵力約 9.6 萬人，其中約 5.6 萬人直接投入耶拿與奧爾施泰特方向的戰鬥；普魯士王國這次總動員約 7 萬人，但真正在戰場上接戰的約 5.3 萬人。戰役首日普軍約有 2.5 萬人死傷或被俘，耶拿一地就有大批士兵放下武器投降，武器裝備損失慘重，幾乎所有野戰炮都落入法軍手中。
冬季消耗戰的數字更不確定。1807 年 2 月 7 日至 8 日的埃爾勞，法軍約 4.5 萬至 5 萬人、俄軍約 6.7 萬人交戰，雙方總傷亡逾 1 萬人，法軍以步兵與騎兵損失最重；2 月 10 日海爾斯貝格，法軍攻勢被擊退，具體損失數字史載有限。6 月 14 日弗里德蘭是雙方記錄相對清楚的一戰：法軍約 5.4 萬人、俄軍約 4.7 萬人交戰，俄軍傷亡約 5,800 人、其中陣亡約 3,000 人，法軍傷亡約 1,000 至 2,000 人。1806 年 11 月布爾根蘭方向的一戰中，普軍損失亦達 2 萬人上下。
條約的量化結果較可靠：1807 年 6 月 25 日的《蒂爾西特和約》使俄國割讓芬蘭並承認法國在波蘭的權勢，7 月 7 日的普魯士和約割去普魯士約一半的國土，面積與人口皆近一半，並支付大筆賠款。
dataEn:
Figures for strengths and losses vary from source to source; the estimates below are the ones most commonly cited, with their uncertainty marked. In the October 1806 campaign Napoleon had roughly 96,000 men available, of whom about 56,000 were committed directly against the Jena and Auerstedt lines; Prussia mobilised some 70,000 in all, but only around 53,000 actually met the enemy in the field. On the first day about 25,000 Prussians were killed, wounded or taken prisoner, large numbers laid down their arms at Jena itself, and equipment losses were catastrophic, with almost every field gun falling into French hands.
The figures for the winter of attrition are less certain. At Eylau on 7 and 8 February 1807 the French engaged with between 45,000 and 50,000 men against roughly 67,000 Russians, with combined casualties above 10,000, the heaviest losses falling on French infantry and cavalry; at Heilsberg on 10 February the French assault was thrown back, and the precise losses there are poorly documented. Friedland on 14 June is among the better recorded: the French fought with about 54,000 men against roughly 47,000 Russians, with Russian casualties of around 5,800, of whom some 3,000 were killed, and French casualties of between 1,000 and 2,000. The action toward Hollabrunn in November 1806 cost the Prussians on the order of 20,000 men as well.
The quantified results of the treaties are more reliable: the Treaty of Tilsit of 25 June 1807 stripped Russia of Finland and acknowledged French predominance in Poland, while the Prussian peace of 7 July removed about half of the Prussian state, in area and in population alike, and imposed a large indemnity.
cause:
直接導火線是 1806 年秋天法軍強行通過普魯士領土。1805 年第三次反法同盟崩潰後，法軍在休戰期間仍以軍隊佔領安斯巴赫等普魯士城鎮，用以封住奧地利與俄國的接合方向，同時要求漢薩城市歸還、禁止普英聯軍借道普魯士境內攻擊法國，並要求普魯士保持中立。普魯士既不肯放棄漢薩城市，也拒絕接受這種主權式的羞辱，1806 年 10 月 9 日正式對法宣戰；十月之後倫敦議定約達成，英國、俄羅斯與奧地利先後加入，反法同盟正式成形。
深層原因是法國革命軍及其後建立的帝國要在歐洲大陸建立霸權，而普魯士、奧地利與俄國都希望維持歐洲均勢，阻止法國把德意志諸邦與波蘭地區納入自己的勢力範圍。1805 年奧地利在奧斯特里茨敗後簽訂的普雷斯堡條約已迫令奧地利退出戰局，拿破崙隨後把目光轉向俄國與德意志諸邦。
經濟層面同樣重要：英國依賴海運與海外市場，法國則在 1806 年 12 月推出大陸封鎖體系，試圖以切斷歐洲大陸貿易來封住英國收入，這使英國必須在陸上尋找盟友分擔壓力，第四次反法同盟正是在這一背景下組成。
causeEn:
The immediate spark was the French armies marching through Prussian territory in the autumn of 1806. After the collapse of the Third Coalition in 1805, French troops still occupied Prussian towns such as Ansbach during the armistice, both to close the seam between Austria and Russia and to ensure that the Anglo-Prussian forces could not use Prussian soil to attack France; the same demands included the return of the Hanseatic cities and a Prussian declaration of neutrality. Prussia would neither surrender the Hanseatic cities nor swallow that kind of humiliation to its sovereignty, and on 9 October 1806 it formally declared war. After the London Convention was concluded later that month, Britain, Russia and Austria joined in turn and the Fourth Coalition took shape.
The deeper cause lay in the French Revolution and the empire that followed it aiming to establish hegemony on the European continent, while Prussia, Austria and Russia all wanted to preserve the European balance of power and prevent France from drawing the German states and the Polish lands into its orbit. The Peace of Pressburg, signed after Austria's defeat at Austerlitz in 1805, had already forced Austria out of the war, and Napoleon then turned his attention to Russia and to the German states.
The economic layer mattered as well: Britain depended on seaborne trade and overseas markets, while France launched the Continental System in December 1806 to strangle British revenue by cutting the trade of the European continent, which forced Britain to seek partners on the land to share the pressure. The Fourth Coalition was assembled in precisely that context.
impact:
戰爭之後，歐洲的權力地圖被重畫。普魯士王國失去約一半土地，被迫加入萊茵聯盟；被俘的普魯士將領與大批士兵被編入法軍的聯軍，1807 年起陸續被派往波蘭、丹麥與日後的西班牙方向作戰，這段為敵人作戰的經歷成為普軍反思與改革的直接教材。俄國的附庸地位延續到 1812 年，芬蘭自此正式併入俄羅斯帝國，華沙公國則成為法國在東歐的衛星國，波蘭問題被推遲到維也納會議才徹底重劃。拿破崙的歐洲體系在 1807 年 6 月 24 日的蒂爾西特達到頂點，法國的影響從北海直抵阿爾卑斯與易北河；但海權仍在英國手裡，陸上的勝利無法換來英國在貿易與承認上的讓步。
軍事層面的影響更為長久：普魯士在戰敗後進行了一輪改革，射擊紀律、步兵縱隊展開速度與後勤安排都有調整，並在 1809 至 1813 年間逐步發展出更現代的合成旅編制；法軍則確立了師級作戰與炮兵集中使用的樣板，隨後在 1809 年奧地利戰爭與 1812 年俄國戰爭中被反覆驗證，也同時暴露了步兵縱隊在消耗戰中的脆弱。德意志邦聯的成立與波蘭問題的懸而未決，讓十九世紀上半葉的德意志統一運動多了一層軍事與外交背景；而這場戰爭留下的回憶錄、戰史與文學，是拿破崙時代史學最常見的素材之一，老近衛與胸甲騎兵的形象因為同時出現在檢閱與戰場上而長久留在人們的記憶中。
impactEn:
After the war the political map of Europe was redrawn. The Kingdom of Prussia lost about half its territory and was forced into the Confederation of the Rhine; captured Prussian officers and large numbers of soldiers were absorbed into French allied contingents and sent from 1807 onwards to Poland, Denmark and later Spain, and that experience of serving the enemy became a direct lesson for Prussian reform. Russia remained a French client state until 1812, Finland was formally incorporated into the Russian Empire, and the Duchy of Warsaw became France's satellite in eastern Europe, with the Polish question left unsettled until the Congress of Vienna finally redrew it. Napoleon's European system reached its summit at Tilsit on 24 June 1807, with French influence running from the North Sea to the Alps and the Elbe; but the seas remained in British hands, and nothing won on land could force a British retreat on trade or recognition.
The military consequences proved longer lasting. Prussia carried out a round of reforms after the defeat, touching marksmanship discipline, the speed with which infantry columns deployed, and logistic arrangements, and between 1809 and 1813 developed a far more modern combined brigade structure; the French army confirmed the pattern of divisional operations with concentrated artillery, a pattern tested and re-tested in the Austrian war of 1809 and the Russian campaign of 1812, which also exposed the vulnerability of infantry columns in an attritional war. The creation of the Confederation of the Rhine and the unresolved Polish question added a military and diplomatic background to the German unification movement of the early nineteenth century. The memoirs, campaign histories and literature left by this war remain among the commonest sources for the Napoleonic era, and the figures of the Old Guard and the cuirassiers, seen both on parade and in the line of battle, stayed long in popular memory.
result:
法國取得全面勝利，但勝利範圍止於歐洲大陸。普軍在耶拿與奧爾施泰特之後遭到摧毀，部隊在 1806 年 10 月底至 12 月陸續放下武器，國王退守東普魯士，國土則在次年 7 月 7 日的和約中被削去約一半。奧地利在西線同樣一敗塗地，1806 年 10 月 26 日普雷斯堡的失敗迫使其退出戰局；1807 年 6 月 14 日弗里德蘭的決定性勝利之後，俄軍崩潰，亞歷山大一世放棄了手中的軍隊，並在 6 月 25 日的《蒂爾西特和約》上簽字，割讓芬蘭、承認法國對波蘭的權勢，並在形式上加入法國主導的大陸體系。
英國沒有達成陸上目標，反而把戰爭轉為海上的持久對抗，1807 年 9 月炮擊哥本哈根是這條路線的高點，法國隨即在 1807 年 12 月實施大陸封鎖體系。整場戰爭留下的結果是：法國取得歐洲大陸的霸權而未能迫使英國屈服，普魯士、俄國與奧地利轉以改革與等待的方式尋求再起，激起了愛國主義與民族主義的政治活動，二十餘年後的民族解放運動因此多了一段共同的記憶，而下一次決戰則要等到 1812 年莫斯科城下。
resultEn:
France won a complete victory, but only within the European continent. The Prussian army was destroyed after Jena and Auerstedt; the formations laid down their arms in stages from late October to December 1806; the king withdrew to East Prussia; and on 7 July of the following year half the Prussian state was stripped away by the peace. Austria was just as badly beaten on the western front, its defeat at Pressburg on 26 October 1806 forcing it out of the war. After the decisive victory at Friedland on 14 June 1807 the Russian army broke, Alexander I gave up the army in his hands, and on 25 June he signed the Treaty of Tilsit, ceding Finland, acknowledging French predominance in Poland, and formally joining the French-led continental system.
Britain achieved nothing on land and turned the war instead into a prolonged struggle at sea, with the bombardment of Copenhagen in September 1807 the high point of that line, answered by the Continental System imposed in December 1807. The net result was this: France obtained hegemony on the continent without bringing Britain to terms, Prussia, Russia and Austria turned to reform and to waiting in their search for another chance, stirring patriotic and nationalist political activity, and the wars of national liberation of the following twenty-odd years inherited a shared memory of the campaign. The next decisive battle had to wait for Moscow in 1812.
